{{Top|leg}}
A '''Class D spacesuit''' was a type of [[Environment suit/Legends|spacesuit]], a life support uniform used to survive in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] or otherwise uninhabitable areas. The rated duration of [[Extra Vehicular Activity]] for a Class D spacesuit was eight [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].
